Newegg
is
an online-only e-commerce retailer specializing in computer hardware, consumer electronics, and gaming gear
. It operates as both a direct seller and an open marketplace for third-party vendors, alongside providing B2B tech procurement and third-party logistics services.
Newegg
Core Business Models
Direct-to-Consumer Retail:
Sells first-party inventory like PC parts, CPUs, graphic cards, laptops, and smart home appliances.
Online Marketplace:
Hosts third-party sellers offering a broader range of lifestyle tech, automotive goods, and hobbyist items.
Business Solutions (B2B & Logistics):
Provides enterprise IT procurement through NeweggBusiness, plus warehousing, fulfillment, and shipping services (Newegg Logistics) for other companies
